name: Harder They Fall [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You can work with an ally to move or knock over a foe that’s too large for either of you to overcome alone.

Prerequisite(s): Str 13, Int 13, Combat Expertise, Power Attack.

Benefit(s): When you use the aid another action to grant an ally a +2 bonus on a bull rush or trip combat maneuver check, the ally can attempt that maneuver even against foes two or more size categories larger than herself.
